# Doubt-Driven Development

## Core idea

For any non-trivial or important decision, spin up a fresh-context reviewer whose one job is to doubt the claim. It is adversarial review during the build, not only at the end.

## How it works

The skill runs a loop: claim, extract, doubt, then resolve. Starting from a clean context keeps the reviewer from inheriting the author's assumptions. It is one of the skills in [[Addy Osmani]]'s pack and is reserved for high-stakes work (production, security, irreversible changes). See [[Skill Pack]] for when this much ceremony pays off.

## Contradictions
_none_
